content: भ्रमिः {%f.%} [भ्रम्-इ] .²1 Whirling or turning round, circular movement; moving about or round, revolution; भ्रमिषु कृतपुटान्तर्मण्डलावृत्तिचक्षुः <ls>U. 3. 19</ls>, <ls n="U.">6. 3</ls>; <ls>Māl. 5. 23</ls>. .²2 A potterʼs wheel. .²3 A turnerʼs lathe. .²4 A whirlpool. .²5 A whirlwind. .²6 A circular arrangement of troops. .²7 An error, a mistake. .²8 Swoon, fainting (मूर्च्छा); <ls>A. Rām. 6. 11. 73</ls>. --{%a.%} Turning round, revolving; क्षौरपव्यं स्वयंभ्रमिम् <ls>Bhāg.</ls>
